operational_quantity: number of occupied q-2t diagonals in stored F_ coordinates
required_encoding_fact: the stored F_ coordinates represent free/rational Khovanov ranks in the stated grading, so the operational occupied-diagonal count is no larger than full homological width
consequence_after_encoding_fact_is_verif: W_Kh >= 4 implies g_T >= 2 and d_alt >= 2; therefore the knot is not almost alternating
not_claimed: This threshold does not by itself prove enrichment in actual Turaev genus or dealternating number, because knots below the threshold can also have g_T >= 2.
